scheme_name: Scheme for Pension Benefits to the Journalists/Photojournalists
other_conditions: Must have retired from the job as an accredited journalist or photojournalist in Tripura.
Must have completed at least 10 years of service in Tripura.
Must not have received a pension from any other source, except under the Employees Provident Fund (EPF).
Beneficiary must be 60 years or older to receive the pension.
